assets.name: ROMs
assets.subject: Generic purple game cartridge with an illustrated paper label and exposed gold contacts
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original static pixel-art ROMs folder icon for ZyperOS.
Primary request: A distinctly new game-cartridge design, different from an upright gray memory card. Make a broad horizontal console game cartridge with a dark plum-blue plastic shell, a warm cream paper label, and a clearly visible bottom connector. It should read as a retro game cartridge even at 40 pixels.
Subject: one squat wide game cartridge, about 1.45 times wider than tall. Straight front view. The main shell has chunky stepped round corners, two short broad horizontal grip ridges on each outer side, and a short wide raised ridge across the top. A completely blank warm cream paper label occupies the central upper half. It is flat matte paper, not glass, not an inset screen. Below it, the shell has a wide rectangular cutout at the bottom center, leaving two short plastic legs at the bottom corners. A narrow green circuit-board tongue extends slightly below the shell between those legs, carrying EIGHT simple broad gold contact bars along its bottom edge. Clearly separate the gold contacts with dark gaps. The green board and gold contacts must be visible from the front, not hidden behind the plastic. Give the whole cartridge a firm, simple game-cartridge silhouette, unlike an SD card, diskette, screen, or handheld console.
Style references: approved ZyperOS GB.png, PS1-ports.png, FOLDER_SMALL.png are style references only, already inspected. Match the chunky square pixel clusters, dark blue-gray outlines, warm upper-left highlights, cool lower-right shadows, and flat three-tone ramps. Do not copy source pixels or real product markings.
Style: bold coarse-grid pixel art, hard stepped edges, flat shading, large clear features, no fine texture and no gradients. Keep the label cream and the shell plum-blue. Small bright gold contact bars provide a clear connector edge.
Composition: square canvas, centered complete cartridge, at least 15 percent transparent margin on every side. Object occupies at most 70 percent of canvas width. No crop.
Background: true transparent alpha. No floor, background color, shadows outside the object, glow, haze, or checkerboard.
Constraints: original generic cartridge. No text, numbers, symbols, logos, brand, game character, artwork on the paper label, buttons, screen, disc, separate objects, photos, tracing, or any existing icon pack.
assets.motionChoice: Static source only. No moving parts and no screen.

checks: The wide purple shell, grip ribs, and exposed circuit board identify a game cartridge.
The cream paper label contains an original mountain scene without words, logos, or game characters.
Eight gold contacts sit along the lower edge, with green and dark gaps between them.
The front view keeps the shell, paper label, and connector aligned.

actualSizeReview.note: The purple cartridge, exposed gold contacts, and original mountain scene remain clear at each size. The paper border stays distinct. No visible glow, text, or brand appears.

correctionPrompts.prompt:
Edit the paper label of this exact purple game cartridge. Preserve the purple plastic shell, silhouette, grip ribs, top ridge, highlights, green connector, eight gold contacts, orientation, object position, transparent square canvas, and all areas outside the label.
Replace the empty cream label with a simple original pixel-art game scene printed on paper. Keep a broad warm-cream paper border around the illustration. Inside that border draw a muted teal sky, one large gold square-pixel sun in the upper-right, two bold dark blue stepped mountain peaks, and a low green ground strip. Use very few large blocks, like a tiny original retro adventure-game cover. The scene should fill most of the label and remain readable as printed artwork at 40 pixels. It must look like ink printed on a paper cartridge label, not a glowing screen. No shine, bezel, glow, glass, icons outside the label, or added objects.
Match the existing coarse square pixel clusters and restrained flat color ramps. No text, letters, numbers, logos, game characters, trademarks, references to real games, copied artwork, or other icon packs. Keep all transparent areas transparent.
correctionPrompts.reason: The user selected the purple cartridge and wanted artwork on the paper label.
correctionPrompts.result: Added an original mountain scene with a teal sky, gold sun, and green ground inside the paper border.
